author: KEXP
description: The playful and adventurous workings of LA-based art-pop group Gelli Haha flip the KEXP Live Room into the Gelliverse. Their lively in-studio session offers a captivating performance of "Normalize" and more from their debut record 'Switcheroo.
title: Gelli Haha performs "Normalize" & more Live on KEXP
